messages:
maria-g: FYI postmortem follow-up: our interop test flagged a repeat VPC peering flap pattern for cust-orrin, looks like on-prem router ARP timeout + our keepalive window. filing a quick action tracker.
aj: this is the same symptom we saw in june for cust-harbor, right? recurring pattern could mean our fallback routing isn't kicking in early enough.
sophie: correct, june incident had same TTL/ARP combination. we added a temporary NACK backoff but never added a config to the private deploy runbook.
ken: root cause from the PM: on-prem NAT device drops neighbor entries during topology churn, KV cache writes keep sending traffic to stale endpoints.
maria-g: action 1 -> ken to own a short patch to reduce keepalive window from 30s -> 10s for Dedicated/private. ETA 48h. (owner: @ken)
ken: ack, I'll open an RFC and a small changelist: will test against our regression harness. linking to my draft: https://rwd.internal/changes/ken/keepalive-10s
sophie: action 2 -> @aj update private-deploy runbook: add ARP timeout mitigation steps + verification checklist. ETA EOD Friday.
aj: onboarding runbook update queued, will include specific `arping` commands and expected metrics from the on-prem agent.
elaine: action 3 -> @maria-g coordinate with SE for cust-orrin patch schedule, they need a maintenance window and hold harmless confirmation.
maria-g: I'll ping SE and propose Wed 02:00 UTC maintenance. also adding a canary rollout: 5% -> 25% -> full if no flaps in 6h per step.
ops-bot: deploy-note: canary policy template created at infra/canaries/peering-mitigation-v1. Add manual approval for 25% -> full.
aj: recurrences: let's add an incident regression tag and check tenant list for similar hardware (brand/model). I can run a query and post list by EOD.
sophie: also proposed long-term: add proactive on-prem probes during initial provisioning to capture ARP/NDP stability. filing a spike for Q2.
maria-g: summary: owners: ken (patch), aj (runbook + tenant scan), sophie (spike), elaine (SE cadence). timelines: patch 48h, runbook EOD Fri, maintenance Wed 02:00 UTC. I'll update the incident doc and mark owners in the tracker.
ken: noted, will update changelist with unit test and run against the nightly onprem suite.
aj: posted tenant scan results: cust-orrin, cust-harbor, cust-lyra look like same hw family, attaching short CSV in the incident doc.
elaine: SE confirmed Wed 02:00 UTC window works for cust-orrin; prepping backout plan.
maria-g: thanks all — please drop short status updates here when tasks are done so I can close the postmortem followups. :thumbsup:
